verdict.rationale: Jan is explicitly open-source and designed to run entirely on the user's own hardware, with build-from-source instructions, a local OpenAI-compatible API server, and network-accessible mode for other devices — core hallmarks of self-hosting. Missing for 10: dedicated server/Docker-style self-hosting deployment guide for multi-user or headless hosting, and independent third-party confirmation of a full self-hosted setup beyond the desktop app.
